# CAT Merging source snapshot

Source: https://github.com/SunWenJu123/model-merging

Commit: `ab87731e405b9eeca1f822685ede0276d756907c`

Copied reference files: `main_catmerging.py`, `methods/cat_merging_utils.py`, `utils/task_vectors.py`, `utils/args.py`. These files retain the upstream implementation and are not directly launched. The upstream snapshot declares no repository license; no new license is assigned here.

Paper: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/sun25i.html and https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06977v2

URS adaptation: `merge_lab/cat.py`, `merge_lab/cat_features.py`. The complete experimental protocol and explicit source-versus-paper discrepancies are documented in `experiment_runs/20261117_cat_seen5/PLAN.md`.
